propositions: Close transitions fail deterministically before LLM dispatch if any unchecked '- [ ]' checkbox item exists in the AC block, unless marked with [operator-attested] tag.
Unchecked items tagged with [operator-attested] (case-insensitive match via shared regex) bypass the precheck and permit close to proceed.
Non-completion close classes (duplicate, not_a_bug, escalated) are exempt from the AC checkbox precheck and retain existing behavior.
Tickets with prose-only AC blocks (no checkbox syntax) pass the precheck unchanged.
The precheck reuses the exact regex matcher from det_operator_attested to prevent drift between the two surfaces.
